
### WFQ exercise  {.smaller}


* suppose A gets 3 shares, B 1 share
* get packets (all arrive at time 0): 
<hr class="vspace" />
* A1, A2, A3, A4, A5 (each 2000 bits)
* B1 (500 bits), B2 (600 bits), B3 (500 bits), B4 (400 bits) 
<hr class="vspace" />
* best order?

### solution {.smaller}

*  weights: A=1 (1 bit per round), B=3 (1/3 of bit per round)
*  A finish time calcuations
    *  A1 at time $0 \text{(current vtime)} + 2000 \text{(size)} \times 1 \text{(weight)} = 2000$
    *  A2 at time $2000 \text{(prev finish)} + 2000 \text{(size)} \times 1 \text{(weight)} = 4000$
    *  A3 at 6000, A4 at 8000, A5 at 10000
*  B finish time calculations
    *  B1 at time $0 + 500 \text{(size)} \times 3 = 1500$
    *  B2 at time $1500 \text{(prev finish)} + 600 \times 3 = 3300$
    *  B3 at 4800, B4 at 6000
*  overall order:
    *  B1, A1, B2, A2, B3, {A3 and B4 in any order}, A4, A5

### solution and virtual time tracking {.smaller}

*  B1 at wallclock times 0-500 (500 bits to send)
   *  sending 4/3 bit per round
   *  virtual time 375 at end = $0 + 500/(4/3)$
*  A1 at wallclock times 500-2500 (2000 bits to send)
   *  virtual time 1875 at end = $375 + 2000/(4/3)$
*  ...
